governance.note: miso-49 keeper recipe verbatim (read from its run_config.json calibration_flags, via scripts/probes/_miso51_gasdaily_hydro.py) with three measured-input changes and zero new fitted parameters: (1) gas_daily_shape now includes MISO — the measured daily Henry Hub within-month swing rides mean-preserving on the per-plant EIA-923 monthly gas level (the code fix in fuel.apply_plant_monthly_fuel_prices re-carries the factors onto overwritten gas plant-months, where the flat monthly overwrite used to erase them); (2) hydro_backfill_year=2024 + hydro_eia930_monthly (the 2025 EIA-923 early release carries 14/160 MISO hydro plants — 0.97 of ~9.9 TWh of zero-MC inflow was previously served by coal); (3) the bundle inherits the rule-23 re-derived measured coal sigmoid at HEAD (miso-50). Targets the miso-50 identified root cause: gas-side daily granularity of the coal-for-gas over-substitution.
governance.validation_note: Reproducible via scripts/probes/_miso51_gasdaily_hydro.py main (git HEAD e96c014 rebased onto main 6f3a524, rubric v2.3 scorer). Rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin: scripts/probes/_miso51_gasdaily_hydro.py ablation. RESULT vs miso-50 (same offer surface): hydro 2025 -8.9 -> -0.1 TWh (fixed); 2023 raw ST_GAS -4.8 -> +1.5 TWh; C3a mean LMP 2025 -2.4% PASS (miso-49 -8.7%) and 2024 +6.1% PASS; C3c scarcity tail OPENS for the first time (miso-49 0/6/3 h; miso-51 33/13/11 h vs DA actual 1/24/38 — 2024 PASSES at 0.54x, 2023 overshoots vs DA but sits at 33 vs 30 h against the RT companion). No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled to land model output on actuals; the daily factors are measured HH quotes, mean-preserving by construction.
governance.residuals_note: DISCOVERED RESULT (honest, not tuned away): the daily gas swing does NOT close the coal over-run — COAL_PRB stays +30.1/+25.1/+26.9 TWh and COAL_BIT +13.7/+15.6/+18.6 (2023/24/25), essentially miso-50's levels. Root cause sharpened by this probe: the coal passthrough sigmoid keys off the SAME daily-shaped gas series (fuel._gas_series), so on trough days the take-or-pay discount deepens in lockstep and the merit order never flips — and the daily whipsaw it imparts to coal offers shows up as the NEW C4 2024 coal dispatch-corr FAIL (r=0.856) and the C3b 2023/24 monthly-shape FAILs. A coal fuel contract's discount posture reprices on a monthly (contract) timescale, not daily spot — keying the sigmoid on the monthly gas level while gas units bid daily is the structurally-correct next lever (one mechanism, no new parameters). 2023 C3a +17.7% is inherited from the miso-50 bituminous gas_mid=4.115 re-derive (coal offers near full cost lift the 2023 price level), not from this probe's changes. All other miso-50 residuals carry over.

disclosures.note: NOT-YET determination (rubric v2.3). The coal-for-gas over-substitution remains the dominant open MODEL MISS: the gas-side daily-granularity fix moved the price surface (C3a 2024/2025 PASS, C3c opens, 2024 tail PASS) and repaired ST_GAS/hydro volumes, but coal level is untouched because the sigmoid's daily gas key moves coal offers in lockstep with the troughs. Recommendation to owner: HOLD as a probe — do not promote; keeper stays miso-49. Next lever: key the coal sigmoid on the monthly gas level (contract-repricing timescale) while gas units keep the daily price — expected to (a) create the real flip days (coal level), (b) clear the new C4 coal-corr and C3b shape regressions (coal offer whipsaw), (c) keep the C3c tail gains.
